body: Image Guidelines for Uploading Product Catalogues on GeM Policy Version 1.0 Date of Policy 20th March, 2025 Effective From 20th March, 2025 These image guidelines are applicable to any seller/OEM uploading a new product catalog onto GeM: 1. The width of the images should not be less than 1000x1000 pixels and the file size should be between 100-300 KB. Only .jpg and .png shall be acceptable. 2. At least 50% (approx.) of the image frame should be filled by the product, ensuring maximum visibility and clarity. Similarly, for 2nd & 3rd Images, at least 35% (approx.) frame should be covered. 3. A seller must upload 3 distinct, sharp, well-exposed images of the product from different angles (e.g., front, back, side, top, interior, and close-ups) to showcase its features, technology, or design. For exceptional cases where 3 distinct images are not possible/relevant, the discretion for image approval shall be with the GeM Team. Rotated images in the name of 3 different images are also not acceptable. 4. A white background is required for all product images. However, for white products, a light grey background may be used to provide contrast and enhance visibility. For exceptional cases, the discretion for image approval shall be with the GeM Team. 5. There should be no reflections or shadows. Proportionate margins around the product must be maintained for visual balance and appeal and relevant images must be uploaded as per the technical specifications. There should be no human presence in the images. 6. Seller must follow the category specific “Special Terms and Conditions” (STC) defined in the category for any additional information/requirement regarding image guidelines for that category. Any such guideline in the Category STC shall supersede the general guidelines for Images, in case of any contradiction. 7. Seller should not Photoshop or edit images in a way that distorts the original appearance of the product. There should be no borderline/outline in the image. 8. Product descriptions, certifications, or specifications should not be added to the product image. These details should be included separately in the listing, no seller details must be visible in the image like contact, name etc. A few categories such as Food, FMCG etc. may be exception. Final decision shall be at the discretion of GeM team for such categories. 9. There should be no additional texts in the images such as “Not for Sale”, “Sample Only” etc. 10. Seller should not upload partial product images, diagrams, or sketches. The entire product, diagrams or sketches must be clearly visible in the frame. 11. Seller should not upload images of product packaging, cartons, or outer boxes. The focus should remain on the actual product. In case of chemicals, fertilizers etc., the containers must be photographed as well. A few categories such as Food, FMCG etc. may be an exception. Final decision for image approval shall be at the discretion of GeM team for such categories. 12. Only one product should be shown per image, except in the case of multiproduct kits, where images should clearly showcase the contents & pack size. 13. A seller should avoid graphical or computer-generated images, unless they are high- quality images used for highly technical products such as electrical, structural items etc. where real-world images may not be available or able to show the product details. In addition to the above guidelines, seller must follow the category specific “Special Terms and Conditions” (STC) defined in the category for any additional information/requirement regarding image guidelines for that category. Any such guideline in the Category STC shall supersede the general guidelines for Images, in case of any contradiction. Over & above the guidelines mentioned above, in case of any exceptional case, the discretion for the image approval shall be with the GeM Team. -------------------------------------------------------End------------------------------------------------------------
